sections_target.text: أعد هذا المستند م. السعيد محمد مطريد، واختبره م. أشرف كمال الدين عتبة، وراجعه م. رضا رجب كرم، واعتمده م. حمدي أحمد درغام مدير عام، وقبله م. مأمون أبو المجد عطا الله رئيس قطاع محطة كهرباء دمنهور.

uncertain_terms.note: 'annually bases' is a typo for 'annual basis'; translated as 'على أساس سنوي'.
'2 UPS unit is rectifier a battery and an inverter' is garbled; translated by intent as two UPS units, each consisting of a rectifier, a battery and an inverter.
uncertain_terms.term: 2 UPS unit is rectifier a battery and an inverter

uncertain_terms.note: 'by bass' is a typo for 'by-pass'; translated as 'احتياطي (by-pass)'.
'0.8 P' is the power factor 0.8; translated as '0.8 معامل القدرة'.
'l.4 v/cell' uses a lowercase L for 1; translated as '1.4 فولت/خلية'.
'Rated Short Time Current No' is a garbled label; translated as 'تيار القصر المقدر للمدة القصيرة'.
'50 Two-Pole Automatic C.B' means 50 two-pole automatic circuit breakers; the second column 'C.B' was translated as 'قاطع دائرة'.
'Rated Power 75 KA' uses kA (current) as the unit for a transformer power rating, which should be kVA; translated verbatim as '75 ك.أ'.
'WEDC.' is a typo for WDEPC (West Delta Electricity Production Company); translated as 'شركة غرب الدلتا لإنتاج الكهرباء'.
'lost reading' is a typo for 'last reading'; translated as 'القراءة السابقة'.
uncertain_terms.term: Compare the present reading with the lost reading

uncertain_terms.note: 'you may use before on lead acid cells' is garbled English; translated by intent as 'فقد تكون استخدمتها من قبل على خلايا الرصاص الحمضية'.
uncertain_terms.term: you may use before on lead acid cells

uncertain_terms.note: '(1.19 kg 1)' is garbled (probably 1.19 kg/l specific gravity); translated verbatim as '(1.19 كجم 1)'.
